'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Jake Nelson DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jake Nelson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
